narrative.overview: DESIGN_SPEC.md names the broader Exbabel visual language Aurora: layered surfaces, light, and a calm shell around energetic accents. These solution pages use a restrained expression of it: white and pale blue sections, dark text, vivid blue actions, rounded diagrams, and small areas of depth. The church translation page is the direct visual precedent for the events and business pages.
keyCharacteristics: Wide two-column hero followed by clearly separated sections.
Sora typography, blue headline emphasis, and muted body copy.
Illustrative translation diagrams with source, bridge, and listener surfaces.
Captions identify prepared examples as illustrative rather than live output.

rules.name: The Accent Rule
rules.body: Use vivid blue for actions and meaningful emphasis, following the church page and its extensions.

rules.name: The Section Rhythm Rule
rules.body: Keep generous vertical spacing, with soft background changes or fine rules to clarify transitions.

dos: Do follow the church page's blue accent, Sora headings, wide gutters, and source-to-listener diagram language when extending solution pages.
Do preserve the distinction between prepared illustrations and live product output in captions.
Do use visible keyboard focus treatment and responsive stacking for dense sections.
donts: Don't treat the new pages' exact section composition as a sitewide template; the church page has its own content and layout variations.
Don't present illustrative hero scenes as measured latency evidence.
